content:
Apple is rolling out new firmware for the AirPods Pro 3 and some other AirPods models, adding support for the latest iOS 27 features.

The new AirPods firmware is launching alongside iOS 27, bringing support for the latest features.

Today, Apple is rolling out iOS 26 for iPhone, and the company is gradually releasing new AirPods firmware that supports the latest features of this update.

The latest AirPods firmware version is 9A348.

Applicable to specified models, including:

  • AirPods Pro 3
  • AirPods Pro 2
  • AirPods Max 2
  • AirPods 4

AirPods 5 will support the new firmware and is expected to go on sale later this week.

Apple's new firmware adds compatibility and support for the latest AirPods features in iOS 27.

  • Custom EQ
  • Works with iPhone-compatible Siri AI
  • Precision Finding via Apple Watch
  • GymKit support
  • Redesigned AirPods settings

About half of the new features are exclusive to AirPods Pro 3, while the rest apply more broadly.

Apple does not provide a way to manually trigger an AirPods firmware update, but has posted instructions on its website on how to make sure the update installs automatically in the background.

Have you installed the new AirPods firmware? What do you think of the new features in iOS 27? Let us know in the comments.
